evidence: batch_0050 (centred AREA, tower HP 8): sable 1.87x, wisp 1.85x, quillan 1.73x and ashwyn 1.59x the roster-mean AP per round, each from a 1-AP AREA on a 1-round cooldown used in 52-81% of affordable rounds. pallas, whose AREA R already has cooldown 2, sits at 1.01x. The lead designer's instruction: increase the cooldown and use the design levers to bring these in line.
hypothesis: A whole-card cooldown of 2 makes the champion miss the round after farming, halving the engine ability's rate; the four should land near or below 1.5x and their win rates move toward 50%. Nothing is bought back.
success_metric: On the same field and HP as the read it is paired with: no champion above 1.5x roster-mean AP per round, and none of the four below 40% win rate in the personality field.
revert_if: Any of the four falls below 35%, or the AREA ability's usage drops below 10% of affordable rounds (the ability has become dead weight rather than priced).
side_effects: Three of the four now carry an ability below the point floor and two kits sit under the band; both are declared as exceptions in the roster and the validator honours a named ability exception (new). Mid loses some wave-clear tempo overall, which may slow sieges a little.
note: Read as batch_0054 on the tower/Nexus HP the pacing pass chooses; the request carries tower 6 / Nexus 8 as a placeholder until batches 0051/0053 are read.

result.verdict: PARTIAL - two of four engines back under 1.5x (wisp, ashwyn); quillan and sable remain above; sable's win rate was under 40% before the patch and stays there

batches.held_constant: rules 1.8.0 in full, tower HP 4, Nexus HP 8, personality field, seed 3801 (paired)

success_metric.none_above_1_5x: not met - quillan 1.56x, sable 1.70x (marrow 1.68x and vellum 1.51x, R-farmers, also above once the mean fell)
success_metric.none_of_four_below_40: not met - sable 36.0 [24.1, 49.9], already 38.0 before the patch

result.reading: The cooldown took a fifth to a third off each engine rather than half: the champion spends the off round on Q/E or moving to the next wave, and the roster mean fell with the engines. wisp and ashwyn are in line; quillan and sable are not. sable earns the most AP on the roster and loses, before and after the patch, which is RQ-047 (under 1.8.0 income and win rate are uncorrelated) - so taxing sable's AREA further is not obviously the next move. Recommendation: read the four on the 4,000-game champion re-read (batch_0057, +/-2.4 points) before another kit lever on the engines; AREA cost 2 stays the candidate for quillan. Predicted side effect landed: Nexus kills 75 -> 69%, median 16 -> 17.
